technique_de_realisation: Mix all the ingredients together, except the chicken broth.
Add the boneless chicken thighs and mix well to coat evenly.
Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for 1 to 2 hours.
Place the chicken thighs on a lightly oiled baking sheet, without overcrowding.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for approximately 25 to 30 minutes, or until the internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C).
Check the color of the chicken before removing it from the oven. Cook a little longer if necessary to obtain a nice golden-brown color.
About 10 to 15 minutes before the end of cooking, pour the chicken broth into the baking sheet and allow it to simmer with the chicken.
Remove the chicken from the oven and collect the cooking juices from the bottom of the pan to use as a sauce.
Serve the chicken thighs with the cooking juices.
